text:
jules: quick ping re: end-of-cycle logistics. small policy updates and a manual review path for sudden leaves. please skim.

rita: whathanged?

jules: 3 items: 1) Rolling 3-day buffer for employees in APAC public-holiday zones (auto-applied by profile timezone). 2) Emergency manual-review flow for hospitalizations/caregiver crises (manager files request, People Ops grants up to 7 business days). 3) New checkbox in the manager form: "partial-cycle-conversion" for contractors converting mid-cycle.

marco: how do managers request the emergency flow?

jules: they add an entry to People Ops Notes with dates and a brief reason, then email people-ops@redwood.com with manager CC. People Ops will log approval and attach it to the review packet.

clare: calibration schedule impact?

jules: calibration remains on June 15-16. we added two overflow slots on June 17 09:00-10:30 UTC and June 18 18:00-20:00 UTC for managers with exceptions. acting reviewers can present if manager is OOO.

hr-bot: reminder: timezone comes from profile > location. If empty, default is org region (NA). Automatic reminders: 5d and 2d pre-deadline. Extensions get 72h and 24h nudges.

rita: retention for exception records?

jules: audit entries kept 18 months. no medical details in summaries shared with managers.

marco: can we get a list of folks with APAC buffers applied?

jules: yes  people-ops will publish a sanitized list to managers by June 1.

clare: thanks, i'll update my manager notes and share the blurb in our next sync.

jules: uploaded kickoff FAQ and copyable manager blurb to the review doc and pinned in #people-ops.

rita: thanks all :thumbsup:
